<translate>
<!--T:5-->
'''Kami's Lookout''' is the sky temple that generates near the world spawn on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. It's home to [[Special:MyLanguage/Korin|Korin]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Dende|Dende]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Mr. Popo|Mr. Popo]], who offer services rather than skills, and it holds the portal to the [[Special:MyLanguage/Hyperbolic Time Chamber|Hyperbolic Time Chamber]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Who lives here == <!--T:6-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:7-->
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Korin|Korin]]''' gives you a [[Special:MyLanguage/Flying Nimbus|Flying Nimbus]] (or a Black Nimbus, depending on your alignment) and 5 [[Special:MyLanguage/Senzu Bean|Senzu Beans]] every 15 minutes.
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Dende|Dende]]''' heals you, resets your character, grows or removes a Saiyan tail and grants Kami's Blessing to Good-aligned players.
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Mr. Popo|Mr. Popo]]''' opens the hair editor ('''Haircut''') for characters with hair. Another Mr. Popo waits inside the Time Chamber.
</translate>

<translate>
== The Time Chamber portal == <!--T:8-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:9-->
The Lookout holds the '''Time Chamber portal'''. Use it to enter the [[Special:MyLanguage/Hyperbolic Time Chamber|Hyperbolic Time Chamber]], the ×10 gravity training dimension. You arrive in the chamber's entry building, whose own portal brings you back to the Lookout.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding it == <!--T:10-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:11-->
Kami's Lookout generates once per world, near the world spawn, in any biome. [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Assistant|Capsule Corp Assistants]] can sell a '''Kami's Lookout Map''' at trade tier 3, for 1 Spruce Sapling and an empty Map. Players with the locate permission can use {{Command|/dmzlocate kamilookout}}. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Finding structures|Finding structures]].
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:12-->
Like every master's home, the Lookout can't be damaged by ki attacks (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Protection|Protection]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:13-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:14-->
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]] quest 19, ''The Sacred Water'': find Kami's Lookout and give Korin 1 Water Bucket.
* Classic Saga quest 46, ''Training at the Lookout'': give Mr. Popo 5 Emeralds.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Saga|Saiyan Saga]] quest 6, ''Provisions for the Lookout'': give Mr. Popo 6 Cooked Dino Meat.
* Saiyan Saga quest 7, ''Sparring at the Lookout'': defeat Krillin, Yamcha and [[Special:MyLanguage/Tien Shinhan|Tien Shinhan (Early)]] at the Lookout.
* Saiyan Saga quest 10, ''Korin's Senzu Beans'': talk to Korin.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Android Saga|Android Saga]] quest 21, ''A New Guardian'': talk to Dende.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Movies Saga]] quest 1, ''Kami's Lookout Warning'': talk to Dende.
</translate>
